# What a user does and sees (compat/apps.rs): each case after its tap.
# base-status-bar
tap id:case-base-status-bar
# platform is told to show: nsh.json's default under the layers of the
# pages and dialogs in the tree, the latest winning field by field.
expect Plain page
# nsh.json's default alone: the root page sets none.
statusbar foreground=dark hidden=true animated=false
# A page over it sets `foreground` only: `hidden` stays nsh.json's.
tap text:Push first
expect First page
statusbar foreground=light hidden=true animated=false
# The next sets `hidden` only: the page below's `foreground` stays.
tap text:Push second
expect Second page
statusbar foreground=light hidden=false animated=false
# A dialog over the pages, animated.
tap text:Open dialog
expect Dialog content
statusbar foreground=auto hidden=false animated=true
# Closing it takes its layer away.
tap text:Close dialog
absent Dialog content
statusbar foreground=light hidden=false animated=false
# Popping takes the pages' away, down to nsh.json's default.
tap text:Pop
expect Routes: plain > first
statusbar foreground=light hidden=true animated=false
tap text:Pop
expect Routes: plain
statusbar foreground=dark hidden=true animated=false
covers [props] statusBar
covers [nsh:rt] setup

absent Hidden 1 2
# The app's annotation shows under new line 1.
expect Note n1
# The ref goes to the first change below the top, then on from it.
tap id:next
expect Hunk: 0
tap id:next
expect Hunk: 1
tap id:current
expect Hunk: current 1
# Revert puts the change's old line back in the new text, reported with
# both texts, which the app sets: one change is left.
tap id:revert-0
expect New: a b c d e f G h
expect Old: a b c d e f g h
tap id:inspect
expect Read: +1 -1 1 [0@6:1>6:1]
# Keep makes the change's new line the old text's: nothing differs.
tap id:keep-0
expect Old: a b c d e f G h
tap id:inspect
expect Read: +0 -0 0 []
# A patch shows its hunk under its header.
expect Header fn main
# With softWrap the patch's long line wraps: no text holds all of it.
absent alpha beta gamma delta epsilon zeta eta theta iota kappa lambda mu nu xi omicron pi rho sigma tau upsilon phi chi psi omega
# A press on its line's number (42) selects the line and presses the
# number; the app's add control shows at the selection's end.
tap text:42
expect Selection: new 0-0
expect Pressed: new 0
expect Add new 0-0
# The ref clears and sets the selection (to the side's lines) and reads
# its text.
tap id:select
expect Selected: true new 0-0 alpha
# A patch of two files: each under the app's header, told the file.
expect File 0 a.ts modified +1 -1
expect File 1 b.ts added +1 -0
expect BETA
# The files, and their changes counted across them.
tap id:files
expect Files: a.ts@0 b.ts@1 hunks 0:0 1:1
# The app's header collapses its file through the ref, reported.
tap id:file-0
expect Toggled: a.ts true
expect File 0 a.ts modified +1 -1 collapsed
absent BETA
tap id:file-0
expect Toggled: a.ts false
expect BETA
covers [props] DiffView.softWrap

covers [props] DiffView.renderAddAnnotation
covers [events] DiffView.onLineSelectionChange
covers [events] DiffView.onLineNumberPress
covers [nsh/base] DiffView
covers [props] DiffView.oldValue
covers [props] DiffView.newValue
covers [props] DiffView.patch
covers [props] DiffView.contextLines
covers [props] DiffView.renderSeparator
covers [props] DiffView.renderHunkActions
covers [props] DiffView.renderFileHeader
covers [events] DiffView.onFileToggle

# base-data-table
tap id:case-base-data-table
# The app draws each cell with the text the table would show: rows 0, 3
# and 4 are not among the rows the app holds, rows 1 and 2 are its two.
expect Cell 1:name fig
expect Cell 2:name pear
expect Cell 2:qty 3
# The rows in view are reported: all five, the last two empty.
expect Visible: 0-5
# A press on a cell selects it, reported.
tap text:Cell 1:name fig
expect Selected: row 1 column 0
expect Pressed: 1:0 1
# Screen readers get a grid named by the app.
prop label:Fruits role grid
# The ref sets the selection without reporting it, and reads it with the
# rows in view.
tap id:select
expect Selected: row 1 column 0
tap id:read
expect Read: 2:1 0-5
tap id:scroll
# A sortable column's sort button reports the next sort, which the app
# sets (`sort`): from it, the next press goes on to descending, then
# clears it.
tap id:sort:name
expect Sorted: name ascending
tap id:sort:name
expect Sorted: name descending
tap id:sort:name
expect Sorted: cleared
covers [events] DataTable.onRowPress
